question.problem:
Suppose that $|\,a\,|=16$, $|\,b\,|=2$ and that the angle between the vectors is $\theta =\frac{2\pi }{3}.$ Find the vector projection of $a$ onto $b$ in terms of the vector $b.$

${\text{proj}}_{b}\,a=$
{{field-1}}
$b$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the scalar projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a & =|\,a\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =16\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{2\pi }{3}) \\  & =16\cdot (-\frac{1}{2}) \\  & =-8\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we find the unit vector that is parallel to $b:$

$$
u=\frac{b}{|\,b\,|}=\frac{b}{2}=\frac{1}{2}b
$$

Finally, we compute the vector projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & ={\text{comp}}_{b}\,a\cdot u \\  & =-8\cdot \frac{1}{2}b \\  & =-4\,b.\end{aligned}
$$
